stages.label: Discover course
stages.behavior: Searches topics and compares course pages
stages.touchpoint: Search results and course detail page

emotion.label: Curious but cautious
emotion.basis: Interviews: worried about time and return

evidence.text: Most people check outcomes and weekly hours first

opportunities.text: Put fit and weekly effort above the fold

actions.check: Hero answers who it is for and weekly effort

stages.label: Compare options
stages.behavior: Opens two or three courses and checks the syllabus

evidence.text: Learners cannot find differences between class formats

opportunities.text: Compare format, assignments, and support in one view

actions.check: Learner selects a format within 30 seconds

stages.label: Try and confirm
stages.behavior: Watches a sample and checks difficulty

emotion.label: More confident
emotion.basis: Follow-up: sample work made the choice easier

evidence.text: Sample work helps judge difficulty better than slogans

opportunities.text: Show real work and feedback examples

actions.check: Every course has two anonymised samples

emotion.label: Hopeful but afraid of errors
emotion.basis: Logs: repeatedly edits contact details before payment

evidence.text: Form errors do not explain how to fix them

opportunities.text: Summarise all details before final submit

actions.check: A corrected field returns to its original position
